title: 時間厳守！どんびーれいと！ (Jikan Genshu! Don't Be Late!)
artist: いずん≒ feat. 音街ウナ

lyrics.rubyText: 晴[は]れ渡[わた]れ The青春[せいしゅん] ワタシ日和[びより]
lyrics.translation: 맑게 개인 The 청춘, 오늘은 나의 날
lyrics.romaji: harewatare The seishun watashi biyori

lyrics.rubyText: 今日[きょう]の予報[よほう]は アンニュイのち最強[さいきょう]
lyrics.romaji: kyou no yohou wa annyui nochi saikyou

lyrics.rubyText: 下[くだ]り坂[ざか]だって 駆[か]け抜[ぬ]けちゃえ
lyrics.romaji: kudarizaka datte kakenukechae

lyrics.rubyText: あとはガムシャラひたすらアガるだけ
lyrics.translation: 이제는 앞만 보고 신나게 달릴 뿐
lyrics.romaji: ato wa gamushara hitasura agaru dake

lyrics.rubyText: アタマん中[なか] ぐるぐる
lyrics.romaji: ataman naka guruguru

lyrics.rubyText: 鳴[な]り響[ひび]く このメロディー
lyrics.romaji: narihibiku kono merodii

lyrics.rubyText: 弱虫[よわむし] 泣[な]き虫[むし] ひっくるめて
lyrics.romaji: yowamushi nakimushi hikkurumete

lyrics.rubyText: 一緒[いっしょ]に元気[げんき]に高[たか]らか、ススメ
lyrics.romaji: issho ni genki ni takaraka, susume

lyrics.rubyText: いますぐ Don't be! Don't be late!で 待[ま]ち合[あ]わせて
lyrics.translation: 지금 바로 Don't be! Don't be late! 함께 만나자
lyrics.romaji: imasugu Don't be! Don't be late! de machiawasete

lyrics.rubyText: まっさらな勇気[ゆうき]を出[だ]して
lyrics.romaji: massara na yuuki wo dashite

lyrics.rubyText: 自分[じぶん]に Don't be! Don't be late!で
lyrics.translation: 스스로에게 Don't be! Don't be late!
lyrics.romaji: jibun ni Don't be! Don't be late! de

lyrics.rubyText: 史上[しじょう]最高[さいこう]に大好[だいす]きなワタシになっちゃえば
lyrics.translation: 세상에서 가장 마음에 드는 내가 된다면
lyrics.romaji: shijou saikou ni daisuki na watashi ni natchaeba

lyrics.rubyText: 生[い]きて 生[い]きて 生[い]きて 昨日[きのう]よりもちょっと良[い]い日[ひ]になるぞ
lyrics.translation: 살고, 살고, 살아가면 어제보다 조금 더 좋은 날이 될 거야
lyrics.romaji: ikite ikite ikite kinou yori mo chotto ii hi ni naru zo

lyrics.rubyText: ときめくリズム 靴[くつ]鳴[な]らして ラ♪ラ♪ララ♪ラララ♪
lyrics.romaji: tokimeku rizumu kutsu narashite ra♪ra♪rara♪rarara♪

lyrics.rubyText: 理不尽[りふじん]な 雨[あめ]だって ポジ ポジティブ
lyrics.romaji: rifujin na ame datte poji pojitibu

lyrics.rubyText: 傘[かさ]でホームランで 打[う]ち返[かえ]しちゃえ
lyrics.romaji: kasa de hoomuran de uchikaeshichae

lyrics.rubyText: 戦略的[せんりゃくてき]撤退[てったい]もオッケーでしょ?でしょ?
lyrics.romaji: senryakuteki tettai mo okkee desho? desho?

lyrics.rubyText: 回[まわ]れ右[みぎ]して 自分[じぶん]らしく 歌[うた]おう
lyrics.romaji: maware migi shite jibun rashiku utaou

lyrics.rubyText: 好奇心[こうきしん] ハモらせて
lyrics.romaji: koukishin hamorasete

lyrics.rubyText: ご清聴[せいちょう] ありがとう
lyrics.romaji: goseichou arigatou

lyrics.rubyText: リスナー ワタシの ひとりでも
lyrics.romaji: risunaa watashi no hitori demo

lyrics.rubyText: やりたい放題[ほうだい] とことん、ススメ
lyrics.romaji: yaritai houdai tokoton, susume

lyrics.rubyText: いつでも Don't be! Don't be late!で 待[ま]ち合[あ]わせて
lyrics.translation: 언제든 Don't be! Don't be late! 함께 만나자
lyrics.romaji: itsudemo Don't be! Don't be late! de machiawasete

lyrics.rubyText: 未来[みらい]の背中[せなか]を押[お]すよ
lyrics.romaji: mirai no senaka wo osu yo

lyrics.rubyText: 明日[あした]も Don't be! Don't be late!で
lyrics.translation: 내일도 Don't be! Don't be late!
lyrics.romaji: ashita mo Don't be! Don't be late! de

lyrics.rubyText: 薔薇[ばら]色[いろ]の人生[じんせい]じゃなくてもワタシ色[いろ]で染[そ]めて
lyrics.translation: 장밋빛 인생이 아니어도 나만의 색으로 물들여
lyrics.romaji: barairo no jinsei ja nakutemo watashiiro de somete

lyrics.rubyText: 泣[な]いて 泣[な]いて 泣[な]いて 涙[なみだ]の海[うみ]で希望[きぼう]を探[さが]そう
lyrics.translation: 울고, 울고, 또 울어도 눈물의 바다에서 희망을 찾자
lyrics.romaji: naite naite naite namida no umi de kibou wo sagasou

lyrics.rubyText: 憧[あこが]れてた あのヒーローとか アイドル 作家[さっか]に 大統領[だいとうりょう]
lyrics.translation: 동경하던 그 히어로도, 아이돌도, 작가도, 대통령도
lyrics.romaji: akogareteta ano hiiroo toka aidoru sakka ni daitouryou

lyrics.rubyText: 諦[あきら]めなきゃ なんでもなれるワタシ どれにしよー、かな?
lyrics.translation: 포기하지 않는다면 뭐든 될 수 있는 나, 뭘 해볼까?
lyrics.romaji: akiramenakya nan demo nareru watashi dore ni shiyo-, kana?

lyrics.rubyText: いますぐ Don't be! Don't be late!で 追[お]い越[こ]し、して
lyrics.translation: 지금 바로 Don't be! Don't be late! 앞질러 가
lyrics.romaji: imasugu Don't be! Don't be late! de oikoshi, shite

lyrics.rubyText: 欲[ほ]しいの、掴[つか]み取[と]りして
lyrics.romaji: hoshii no, tsukamitorishite

lyrics.rubyText: 誰[だれ]より Don't be! Don't be late!で 自分[じぶん]を信[しん]じて、ススメ
lyrics.translation: 누구보다 Don't be! Don't be late! 자신을 믿고 나아가
lyrics.romaji: dare yori Don't be! Don't be late! de jibun wo shinjite, susume

lyrics.rubyText: いますぐ Don't be! Don't be late!で 待[ま]ち合[あ]わせて
lyrics.translation: 지금 바로 Don't be! Don't be late! 함께 만나자
lyrics.romaji: imasugu Don't be! Don't be late! de machiawasete

lyrics.rubyText: まっさらな勇気[ゆうき]を出[だ]して
lyrics.romaji: massara na yuuki wo dashite

lyrics.rubyText: 自分[じぶん]に Don't be! Don't be late!で
lyrics.translation: 스스로에게 Don't be! Don't be late!
lyrics.romaji: jibun ni Don't be! Don't be late! de

lyrics.rubyText: 史上[しじょう]最高[さいこう]に大好[だいす]きなワタシになっちゃえば
lyrics.romaji: shijou saikou ni daisuki na watashi ni natchaeba

lyrics.rubyText: 駆[か]けて 駆[か]けて 駆[か]けて どんな天気[てんき]も楽[たの]しんじゃえ
lyrics.translation: 달려, 달려, 달려 어떤 날씨라도 마음껏 즐겨
lyrics.romaji: kakete kakete kakete donna tenki mo tanoshinjae

lyrics.rubyText: 友情[ゆうじょう] 愛情[あいじょう] 虹色[にじいろ] てんこ盛[も]り
lyrics.romaji: yuujou aijou nijiiro tenkomori

lyrics.rubyText: 遥[はる]か 彼方[かなた] 突[つ]き抜[ぬ]けて Don't be late!
lyrics.translation: 아득한 저 너머까지 뚫고 나가, Don't be late!
lyrics.romaji: haruka kanata tsukinukete Don't be late!

lyrics.rubyText: ときめくリズム 靴[くつ]鳴[な]らして ラ♪ラ♪ララ♪ラララ♪
lyrics.romaji: tokimeku rizumu kutsu narashite ra♪ra♪rara♪rarara♪
